structure.unit: Offenses Relating to Railroads and Other Utilities

law.catch_line: Unlawful use of, or injury to, telephone and telegraph lines; copying or obstructing messages; penalty

text.section:
If any person, with the intent to prevent another person from summoning law-enforcement, fire, or rescue services:
Commits any act set forth in subsection A; or
Maliciously prevents or interferes with telephone or telegraph communication by disabling or destroying any device that enables such communication, whether wired or wireless, he is guilty of a Class 1 misdemeanor.
